why_this_can_go_viral: Connecting a beloved monster to a horrifying real disease creates a 'mind blown' moment that drives shares.

title: The Aztec Myth Where the Sun Refused to Rise Until It Was Fed Hearts

title: The Egyptian Myth Where a Goddess Drank the Blood of Ra Until He Was Weak
